description: A display-only overlay triggered by hover or keyboard focus on the trigger element. Built on Radix UI Tooltip which provides role="tooltip" and links the content to the trigger via aria-describedby. Tooltip content is not keyboard-interactive.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the trigger element, which opens the tooltip

focus.notes: The tooltip appears when the trigger receives keyboard focus and disappears when focus leaves. The tooltip content itself is not focusable and does not participate in the tab order.

announcements: Tooltip content is announced as a description of the trigger via aria-describedby
The role="tooltip" identifies the element as supplementary information
screenReader.notes: Tooltip content should be concise and supplementary. It should not contain essential information that the user cannot access by other means.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — tooltip uses popover-foreground on popover background

consumerResponsibilities: Do not place essential information only in tooltips
Keep tooltip content short and descriptive
Ensure tooltips do not obscure other interactive elements
Avoid interactive content (links, buttons) inside tooltips
